{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Define the group
mask_new_paid_search = (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')

count_new_paid_search = mask_new_paid_search.sum()
print(f"Total count in group: {count_new_paid_search}")

# Check for refunded orders in this group
refunded_in_group = df.loc[mask_new_paid_search, 'status'] == 'refunded'
print(f"Number of refunded orders in group: {refunded_in_group.sum()}")

# Correct conversion count: only 'completed' status, not 'converted' column
completed_in_group = df.loc[mask_new_paid_search, 'status'] == 'completed'
converted_count_correct = completed_in_group.sum()
print(f"Number of completed orders in group: {converted_count_correct}")

# Check if any QA orders are in this group
qa_orders_in_group = df.loc[mask_new_paid_search, 'revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f"Number of QA orders in group: {qa_orders_in_group.sum()}")

# Check if any QA orders are in the completed group
if qa_orders_in_group.sum() > 0:
    print(f"QA order IDs in completed group: {df.loc[mask_new_paid_search & completed_in_group & qa_orders_in_group, 'order_id'].tolist()}")

# Final fraction
fraction_converted = converted_count_correct / count_new_paid_search
print(f"Final fraction converted (using 'completed' status): {fraction_converted}")"}
